title: WD-002 - WS2 CP4A Mode Sync + Display Status

selected_candidate.title: Mode sync and display status foundation

user_purpose: Windows Desktop follows keyboard-authoritative current mode, supports Desktop-initiated mode switch only after firmware confirmation, preserves local drafts while disconnected, and shows a readable status summary.

user_journey.summary: Connect over USB/BLE, read keyboard mode, follow keyboard-originated changes, set mode from Desktop only after 0x92 OK plus 0x00 readback match, preserve local drafts offline, read keyboard truth first on reconnect.

commands.purpose: status readback for keyboard-authoritative current mode and status fields
Desktop-to-keyboard mode set with one valid target mode byte

protocol_summary.success_rule: Desktop mode set succeeds only after 0x92 OK and follow-up 0x00 readback equals requested mode.
protocol_summary.failure_rule: Non-OK response, timeout, disconnect or readback mismatch returns visible state to keyboard-authoritative mode.
protocol_summary.transport_policy: USB and BLE must expose equivalent behavior; active Desktop control channel owns mode-set attempts while connected.

windows_expected_behavior: Read current mode from device status readback.
Keep visible mode aligned with keyboard-originated mode changes.
Allow Desktop-originated mode switch only while connected.
Send 0x92, then require 0x00 readback match before success UI/state.
On failure, timeout, disconnect or mismatch, return to keyboard truth and show a recoverable failure state.
While disconnected, allow local browsing/editing but disable Save/Apply and any 0x92 apply path.
On reconnect, read keyboard truth first and do not replay stale local draft state.
Preserve unapplied local drafts as drafts.
Show mode summary with primary key labels, battery percent, charging state and readable connection/status labels.
Preserve existing Mode1/2/3 visuals; Mode4 remains empty/placeholder until a later authorized scope.
Preserve WD-001 recovery expectations for 0x95 sleep timeout and 0x9F firmware catalog key.

change_classification.protocol_change_note: Windows behavior and verification policy over existing 0x00 / 0x92; no new Firmware opcode.
